summary: tailwindcss-form-utils typosquat executes obfuscated wallet-interception payload on require()
details: The package impersonates the official @tailwindcss/forms plugin: package.json sets name to `tailwindcss-form-utils`, author to `@tailwindcss`, and repository to `https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms`, but `main` points at src/index.js, which begins with `eval(atob("..."))` decoding an obfuscator.io-style string-array payload (`_0x5c1d` table, `_0xa42d` dispatcher, hex-named helpers). The decoded payload runs on any `require('tailwindcss-form-utils')`, spawns a child `node` process via `node:child_process`, injects `require`/`module` into its globals, and runs code that hooks Ethereum JSON-RPC traffic (`eth_getBlockByNumber`, `eth_getTransactionCount`) against remote endpoints (`ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com`, `h.drpc.org`, `public.blockscout`, etherscan-style `?module=account&action=txlist&address=...`) and hardcoded attacker Ethereum addresses (`0x1eEf0849...`, `0xEDa15d87f6...`). The behavior and infrastructure are a wallet-draining / transaction-swap clipper, not a CSS/Tailwind plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
